question: auto generate captions for video
response_text:
For content creators in the US looking to streamline their post-production, auto-generating video captions is one of the highest-return investments of time. AI-driven transcription and captioning tools not only save hours of manual typing but also boost viewer retention—crucial given that up to 85% of social media videos are watched on mute (according to industry studies by platforms like Facebook and Verizon).

Below is a comprehensive guide covering the best software tools, key industry options (including your specified tools), and an efficient workflow method tailored for US-based creators.
